Chosen over (b) because section 2.1's type was already written as a uniform tuple and the release clause's documented behavior already assumed a uniform 2-tuple destructure -- (a) is the smaller, consistent change. Section 8's scope-confirmation list updated to explicitly include the :global try_acquire clause among changed function bodies. Alias note in section 3 corrected: routers/tenants.ex already aliases Letflow.TenantProvisioning (line 160, verified), only alias Letflow.Admission needs adding. Re-verified section 2.1 end to end: state type declarations -> both try_acquire clauses -> release_tenant/2's generation-comparison contract -> the interleaving traces, all reference one uniform state.refs shape with no remaining bare-atom producer. Self-check grep for defmodule|def |defp |schema "|Enum.|fn ->|case do|cond do|with do|pipe operator over the whole doc: zero matches.
